[\"对每个询问进行约数分解。然后依次搜索每个数换成某个比它大的因数之后能不能达.en: Perform prime factorization for each query. Then sequentially check if replacing each number with a factor larger than itself can reach the target. Pruning: 1. Because of [[A0]], if there are more than 30 numbers greater than 1, it is definitely impossible to reach the target. Therefore, the actual candidates entering dfs do not exceed 30. 2. For the suffix product array, if the remaining numbers are smaller than the current suffix product, multiplying them will definitely be too large and can be pruned. 3. Use lru_cache for memoized search.
